task: four mutually exclusive native-resolution material phases; image-macro GT-present IoU

sources.title: HuBMAP+HPA 2022 third-place authors code
inspected: code_base/inference/inference_class.py: per-organ thresholds, relative minimum component area, weighted models
sources.adaptation: Class thresholds become offsets of a four-class probability argmax. Prediction-derived phase ratios replace organ metadata, which KoMaP does not provide. Retain native masks and protect boundary-touching Primary components.
sources.license: No license file listed in inspected repository tree; source samples are read-only research references, not redistributed in release implementation.

sources.title: HuBMAP+HPA 2022 seventh-place author writeup
sources.observations: Mixed whole images and tiles, random crop probability .5; D4 and model aggregation.
sources.adaptation: Prospective full-native / crop512 mixture with uniform image sampling, mild grayscale-only augmentation and optional class-balanced crop centers. Avoid histology-specific color shifts and resizing thin Eutectic Si.

sources.title: HuBMAP+HPA 2022 first-place author writeup
sources.observations: Whole-image SegFormer ensemble, CE/Lovasz, per-organ thresholds.
sources.adaptation: Use overlap-oriented loss plus CE, native whole-image supervision; validate exact KoMaP IoU instead of importing Dice thresholds.

sources.title: Semi-Supervised Segmentation of Functional Tissue Units at the Cellular Level
sources.observations: Primary paper associated with third-place solution; segmentation under domain shift and imbalance.
sources.adaptation: No external histology labels or test pseudo-labels introduced; domain mismatch means results cannot be assumed transferable.

sources.title: Severstal Steel Defect Detection, 31st-place authors code
sources.inspected: inference.py: per-class thresholds, min-area suppression, multiple encoders and TTA aggregation
sources.adaptation: Confirms class-dependent decision calibration as a competition strategy. In KoMaP retain exclusive four-class argmax and reassign removed Primary pixels; do not copy independent binary masks or defect-absence Dice rewards. No arbitrary area suppression of thin Eutectic Si.
sources.implementation: Existing ensemble and class-calibration ablations; source inspected read-only, not executed or redistributed.

sources.title: Long-tail learning via logit adjustment
sources.adaptation: Additive class-score adjustment is related; our bounded prediction-composition regression is an empirical extension optimized for KoMaP hard IoU, not the paper's prior-frequency rule or a theoretical guarantee.

sources.title: The Lovasz-Softmax loss
sources.adaptation: Supports distinction between image-wise and dataset-wise IoU optimization. Existing matched R022 control includes per-image present-class Lovasz; new candidate uses explicit GT-present soft-IoU plus CE, which is not claimed to be Lovasz.

operator_metric.present_rule: S_i={c: ground_truth_count_i,c>0}; excluded even when prediction contains c
operator_metric.pixel_errors: Pixels wrongly assigned to GT-absent classes still count as FN for their true class.

training_objective.formula: L = .8 * mean_i[1 - mean_{c in S_i}(sum_p y_icp p_icp / (sum_p y_icp + sum_p p_icp - sum_p y_icp p_icp))] + .2 * mean_i mean_p CE(y_ip,p_ip)
training_objective.coefficients: Experimental choice; not official requirements. Matched R022 control retained.
training_objective.full_image_vs_patch: Metric alignment exact in presence/averaging for full image surrogate. Patch steps are a separate surrogate and ablated.

ensemble_objective.fit: maximize exact official hard IoU on fit images; each heldout group excluded from fitting weights/calibration/component thresholds
ensemble_objective.conditional_features: Predicted phase composition and optionally prediction entropy only. No filename, GT presence, test label, or manual mask editing at inference.

limitations: Only provided valid20; repeatedly used for checkpoint/candidate/model selection. Group crossfit diagnoses current fitting stage only; not independent nested CV.
Research-inspired extension, not a claim of worldwide novelty.
Kaggle Dice/leaderboard numbers are not comparable to KoMaP mIoU.
No test images used by Oct09 search/training.
